description: CLI exit-code resolution (registry/exit-codes.json resolution.rules, spec 7.3). States are matched as (operation, final_state). Every exit code is produced by at least one case.

cases.name: command-succeeded-without-state
cases.note: e.g. sprut model list

cases.name: setup-plan-shown
cases.note: SEC-m2: read-only setup plan reached its outcome; the plan now waits for consent

cases.name: action-required-virtualization
cases.note: TC44

cases.name: action-required-state-wins-over-reason
cases.note: ENGINE_REMOTE_CONTEXT maps to 1, the ACTION_REQUIRED state gives 3

cases.name: apply-without-yes-no-tty
cases.note: TC27, SEC-m2: apply was meant to leave WAITING_FOR_CONSENT; host unchanged

cases.name: apply-yes-without-licence-acceptance
cases.note: CR-20: sprut setup apply --plan-id X --yes without --accept-license (or --accept-docker-group / --accept-distro-removal): consent is not set, the host is unchanged

cases.name: privilege-without-tty
cases.note: earlier plan steps may already have changed the host

cases.name: reboot-required
cases.note: TC17

cases.name: relogin-required
cases.note: TC29

cases.name: sigint-without-operation
cases.note: e.g. Ctrl+C during sprut model pull

cases.name: stream-ended-mid-operation
cases.note: SEC-m1: the core died during IMAGE_PULL; no result/error event and no terminal or waiting state

cases.name: profile-locked-no-operation
cases.note: the command neither started nor attached to an operation

cases.name: foreign-distro-action-required
cases.note: 0.2.0: a resource with the Sprut name that is not Sprut's needs a human; the ACTION_REQUIRED state gives 3

cases.name: cleanup-foreign-resource
cases.note: 0.2.0: FOREIGN_RESOURCE maps to exit code 1

cases.name: plan-invalid
cases.note: 0.2.0: a plan that violates the contract is never shown or executed

cases.name: plan-stale
cases.note: TC28

cases.name: unregistered-reason-code
cases.note: a code from a newer contracts version falls back to 1

cases.name: ready-of-unregistered-operation-is-not-success
cases.note: SEC-M4: states are keyed by the operation's machine; an unknown operation kind matches no state rule

cases.name: model-pull-succeeded
cases.note: CR-18: task SUCCEEDED

cases.name: model-pull-source-unavailable
cases.note: task FAILED takes the reason code's exit code

cases.name: mode-switch-drain-timeout
cases.note: CR-14/CR-18: the mode_switch task fails with DRAIN_TIMEOUT while node_status stays DRAINING

cases.name: task-stream-ended-while-running
cases.note: SEC-m1/CR-18: the core died while the task was RUNNING

cases.name: node-drain-timeout-stays-draining
cases.note: CR-14: node stays DRAINING; the mode-switch operation fails with DRAIN_TIMEOUT

cases.name: node-offline-after-auth-rejected
cases.note: bootstrap-only rules never match another operation
